source: OmgevingsChat (IGNE Agency), handed to the team; not in git (company data)
import: uv run omgkg import-snapshot Snapshot/<file> --collection kg-maastricht

maastricht_omgevingsplan.chunking: per lid for articles with leden, per article otherwise; explanatory notes and definitions as their own chunks
